meta.name: Ketika Manusia Mengenal Api (HumanFireShort)
meta.mood: hangat sinematik dokumenter — senja plum-indigo menuju keemasan api unggun dan peradaban
meta.styleReference: Adapted aesthetic DNA from Earth 24 Hours (layered 2D diorama silhouettes, dynamic rim-lighting, glowing serif headers, hand-torn parchment subtitle cards, subtle paper grain) — zero clock dial, 100% pure code.

palette.usage: 60% deep plum/indigo shadows & atmospheric midtones, 30% warm earth/silhouettes, 10% glowing firelight & rim highlights. Zero #000 or #fff.

dominantSources: S1: Setting sun transitioning to cool pale moonlight (#9ab4d4)
S2: Sharp storm lightning flash (#dceeff) -> wild burning tree (#f8a64a)
S3-S5: Warm flickering campfire hearth (#f8b65c) casting rim-light & trembling cave shadows
S6: Terracotta kiln glow (#e8682c) -> white-gold molten bronze (#fff2c6)
S7: Intimate ember -> forge fire -> golden modern city skyline (#f8c46c)
light.rimLighting: Every hero character & foreground prop computes fire-facing warm rim edges dynamically from (fireX, fireY).
light.castShadows: Dynamic soft ground & cave-wall shadows cast strictly away from active light origin, trembling with fire flicker.

shape.language: Organic painterly smooth Bezier silhouettes with expressive articulated limbs, layered hills/foliage, and tactile hand-torn parchment cards
shape.outline: Dynamic rim-lit edge stroke only on light-facing contours (no uniform thick cartoon outlines)

typography.subtitleCard: Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif (deckle-edge parchment card, centered safe zone)
